about: What rac3-ntsc's carried tables rest on besides the same code, written by port/tools/hostgen/release_carry_rac3.py; do not edit.

left_out.func_003A2BC0__frontbin: PAL-only overlay pad startup: NTSC-U's boot caller 0x003984CC initializes the core records through 0x003A2E80; frontbin enters at 0x0037D200 and calls the existing-pad iterator 0x0039E8E0 at +0x400 and +0x8D4 without pad/library initialization. Its records start at 0x001D5680, above the retained pad records and core pointers; no NTSC startup is invented or substituted.
left_out.func_L01_00460868: PAL-only overlay pad startup: NTSC-U's level 1 entry 0x003EE988 uses iterator 0x0045E370 and updater 0x0045DF40 on the boot-initialized core pad records. All 34 NTSC-U SP programs start their records at 0x001D5680, overlap no pad/core-pointer state, and have no calls to pad/library init or port open and no GP-relative stores to the port-one core pointers. Preserve that lifecycle rather than bind a nonexistent overlay initializer.
left_out.func_003AA3C8__frontbin: DrawWidgetSpriteFrontbin: since rac3-decomp f9ea1754 NTSC-U's release view names PAL's frontbin func_003AA3C8 func_003A4E70 without its program's suffix, so frontbin's C calls a stub and the row would bind the boot program's address (inside func_003A4688); left out until the release view names it as frontbin's again
